name: reel-firebase-tests
description: Offline browser unit tests and Firestore/Storage permission tests for Reel. Emulator tests use demo-reel and require Java 21+.

scripts.test: cd ../.. && node firebase/tests/configure-emulator.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --config .reel/test-fixture/firebase.local.json --only firestore,storage --project demo-reel "node --test firebase/tests/storage.rules.test.mjs firebase/tests/firestore.rules.test.mjs firebase/tests/public.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.recorder-smoke: cd ../.. && node firebase/tests/configure-emulator.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --config .reel/test-fixture/firebase.local.json --only auth,firestore,storage --project demo-reel "node firebase/tests/recorder-smoke.mjs --emulators"
scripts.unit: node --test core.test.mjs fmp4.test.mjs cloud.test.mjs capture.test.mjs audio.test.mjs encoder-worker.test.mjs publisher-transcription.test.mjs publisher-access-race.test.mjs shared-title.test.mjs meeting-transcription.test.mjs cloud-meeting-speech.test.mjs meeting-delivery.test.mjs organization.test.mjs meeting-policy.test.mjs
